description_en: Sends the processing result of an extension point event by an extension to DataWorks
description_zh: 用于在DataWorks平台使用过程中触发扩展点时，通过调用CallbackExtension接口，将扩展程序对扩展点事件的检查结果返回给DataWorks平台
name: CallbackExtension

parameters.help_en: The unique code of the extension
parameters.name: extension_code

parameters.help_en: The message ID in DataWorks OpenEvent. You can obtain the ID from a received message when an extension point event is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks开放消息的消息ID。当触发扩展点事件后，您可以从接收到的事件消息中获取消息ID。

<props="china">消息格式，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html。</props>
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en:
The check status of the extension point event. Valid values:

*   OK: The event passes the check.
*   FAIL: The event fails to pass the check. You must check and handle the reported error at the earliest opportunity to ensure that your program is run as expected.
*   WARN: The event passes the check, but an alert is reported
parameters.help_zh:
扩展程序对本次扩展点事件的检查状态。取值如下：
- OK：扩展程序对本次扩展点事件检查通过。
- FAIL：扩展程序对本次扩展点事件检查不通过。您需要查看并及时处理报错，以免影响后续程序的正常执行。
- WARN：扩展程序对本次扩展点事件检查通过，但存在警告
parameters.name: check_result

parameters.example: The xxx rule is hit. Modify it and try again.
parameters.help_en: The check message of the extension point event. If CheckResult is set to FAIL, you must provide the failure cause
parameters.name: check_message
